method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob 8cc39ea9d27d. Every cited URL was fetched; dead links and pages that never mention the character were removed, and feats, results, conditions and campaign tags that lost their source were moved to unknowns. All records provisional.

characters.summary: Billy Sole is a tracker and scout for Dutch's rescue team, relying on his tracking skills, knife combat, and a submachine gun. He bravely makes a final stand with a machete against the Predator.

sources.supports: Billy Sole's role as tracker and his final confrontation with the Predator.

feats.claim: Tracks the guerrilla forces through dense jungle terrain
Makes a final stand against the Predator using only a machete on a bridge

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed in hand-to-hand combat after dropping his rifle.

unknowns: Exact details of his military background prior to the rescue mission.

characters.summary: Bishop is an android science officer possessing superhuman physical resilience, exceptional dexterity, and advanced technical knowledge, though he is vulnerable to physical impalement and tearing.

mechanisms: Synthetic physiology (immune to biological acid to some degree, lacks human pain)

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being torn in half or impaled by heavy mechanical objects
limitations: Cannot regenerate lost lower torso parts

sources.supports: Bishop's identity as an android, his technical skills, and his fate in Aliens.

feats.claim: Performs the knife trick at high speed between a crew member's fingers
Remotely pilots a dropship to rescue survivors from the hive

notableResults.note: Torn in half by the Queen while holding onto Newt.

campaignTags.claim: Bishop is an artificial person / android created by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation.
Possesses advanced technical knowledge and pilots dropships.
Remotely pilots or flies the UD-4L Cheyenne Dropship.

unknowns: Exact structural composition of synthetic blood and internal components.

characters.summary: Bryan Mills is a retired CIA operative who utilizes extreme tactical expertise, brutal hand-to-hand combat, interrogation techniques, and firearm proficiency to neutralize criminal syndicates single-handedly.
weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability to bullets and physical trauma
limitations: Peak human physical limits with age-related endurance constraints

sources.supports: Bryan Mills's CIA background, skills, and combat feats in Taken.

feats.claim: Infiltrates a heavily guarded Parisian residence and eliminates multiple armed kidnappers
Tracks down an international trafficking ring through meticulous detective work and intimidation

notableResults.note: Defeats his former CIA colleague in a physical altercation.

campaignTags.claim: Infiltrates high-security criminal compounds and human trafficking rings undetected.
Utilizes stealthy infiltration and silent takedowns during rescue missions.

unknowns: The full extent of his classified black-ops missions prior to retirement.

characters.summary: Colonel Bagley is a disciplined and ruthless mid-19th-century military officer armed with period firearms and sabers, commanding troops with strict tactical doctrine.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to close-quarters melee weapons when caught off-guard
limitations: Dependent on 19th-century weaponry and military doctrine

sources.supports: Colonel Bagley's role, military background, and actions in The Last Samurai.

feats.claim: Commands imperial troops against traditional samurai forces in the fog battle

notableResults.note: Killed during the decisive battle against Katsumoto's forces.

campaignTags.claim: Fights and commands troops while riding horses.

unknowns: Complete history of his service in the American Civil War.

characters.summary: Colonel Sam Trautman is a seasoned Green Beret commander skilled in military strategy, firearms, and negotiation, acting as both mentor and tactical supervisor to John Rambo.
limitations: Human physical stamina and aging constraints

sources.supports: Colonel Trautman's background as a Green Beret officer and mentor to Rambo.

feats.claim: Navigates hostile war zones and negotiates with adversaries to rescue or locate Rambo

notableResults.note: Captured and tortured by Soviet troops before being rescued by Rambo.

unknowns: Full record of his early Green Beret missions.

characters.summary: Commodus is a Roman Emperor who fights with underhanded tactics, daggers, and concealed weapons in the arena, relying heavily on political power and bodyguards.
weaknesses: Psychologically unstable, prone to panic and physical fatigue
limitations: Relies on unfair advantages and corrupt authority

sources.supports: Commodus's character traits, combat style, and final duel in Gladiator.

feats.claim: Stabs Maximus with a hidden stiletto prior to their final arena duel to gain an unfair advantage

notableResults.note: Killed by Maximus in the Colosseum despite entering the fight with a pre-existing wound inflicted on Maximus.

unknowns: True extent of his formal combat training versus street/arena brawling.

characters.summary: Conan is a Cimmerian warrior of immense physical strength and prowess, utilizing broadswords, axes, and stealth to defeat mortal and supernatural foes.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful sorcery and overwhelming numbers without prep

sources.supports: Conan's Cimmerian heritage, weapon mastery, and feats in the 1982 film.

feats.claim: Slashes through dozens of Thulsa Doom's guards in temple combat
Scales the heavily guarded Tower of Serpents undetected

notableResults.note: Defeats multiple guards in single and group combat.

campaignTags.claim: Infiltrates the Tower of Serpents using stealth and climbing skills.

unknowns: Extent of his resistance to various forms of ancient sorcery.

characters.summary: Deputy Art Galt is a small-town law enforcement officer who employs standard firearms, patrol vehicles, and tracking dogs, though he is hot-headed and undisciplined.

mechanisms: Law enforcement body armor and vehicles

weaknesses: Arrogant, loses composure under pressure, lacks wilderness survival skills compared to Rambo
limitations: Average physical fitness and tactical discipline

sources.supports: Deputy Art Galt's role as a law enforcement officer in First Blood.

feats.claim: Tracks John Rambo into the mountainous forest with a police dog and armed deputies

notableResults.note: Falls to his death from a cliff edge after Rambo throws a rock at his helicopter.

unknowns: Prior law enforcement record before the events in Hope, Washington.

characters.summary: Al Dillon is a CIA operative and former Green Beret armed with assault rifles and tactical gear, skilled in covert operations and firearms combat.
weaknesses: Overconfident in corporate/government authority and firepower

sources.supports: Dillon's CIA background, weapons loadout, and death in Predator.

feats.claim: Leads a joint assault on a heavily defended guerrilla encampment
Engages the Predator with an arm-mounted machine gun after losing an arm

notableResults.note: Killed by the Predator after getting his arm severed.

unknowns: Full extent of his CIA black-ops activities prior to the Central American operation.

characters.summary: Major Alan "Dutch" Schaefer is an elite paramilitary rescue team leader who combines exceptional physical strength, improvised trap-making, guerrilla tactics, and heavy weaponry to survive and defeat superior alien hunters.

techniques: Assault rifle and grenade launcher combat

mechanisms: Extreme pain tolerance and physical conditioning

weaknesses: Vulnerable to advanced plasma weaponry and physical trauma if caught without traps
limitations: Peak human physical limits without superhuman regenerative powers

sources.supports: Dutch Schaefer's military leadership, survival tactics, and defeat of the Predator.

feats.claim: Constructs complex booby traps and a counter-attack bow from jungle materials
Covers himself in mud to completely mask his body heat from thermal vision
Defeats a Predator in single combat using traps and blunt force

notableResults.note: Wins through clever trap-making, guerrilla warfare, and endurance after all squad members are killed.

unknowns: His exact whereabouts and activities following his helicopter extraction at the end of the film.
